## {{< animate fadeInDown "Welcome!" >}}

I am a [Professor of Transport Data Science](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport/staff/953/dr-robin-lovelace) at the [University of Leeds](https://www.leeds.ac.uk/) [Institute for Transport Studies](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport). 🚶🚴🚲🚗🚌🚆

I work with teams to help them build open tools 💻 and internationally deployed reproducible workflows and web applications 🌍 for evidence-based transport planning. 🚀

I share code, methods, and writing on [GitHub](https://github.com/robinlovelace) and in the [posts section](/posts/). If you would like to collaborate, feel free to [get in touch](mailto:r.lovelace@leeds.ac.uk)! ✉️

[Current projects](/projects/){.btn .btn-primary .me-2}
